# Tip: Guaranteed to force Queen (and firebeasts) to land

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_53_nukaknights-post-brandbestien-queen-landung.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This tip is of course especially important for Queen events, i.e. “**scorched earth**”. But of course it also makes sense to know this tip for forays into Appalachia.

This tip is also important for **mutated events**. e.g. In "Against the Sound Barrier" there are also **fire beasts** with the mutation "**Toughened**". If they haven't shot down to 1 HP yet, you can also force these fire beasts to land this way.

The goal is to "cripple**" at least one wing.

## Basic Perk

To do this you always need the perk card "**concentrated fire**" (1 is enough) under **Perception**, as well as a ranged weapon. Rifles are best because of their range and precision.

## Commando/Rifle Shooter Builds:

The perk card "**Tormentor**" (preferably at 3) under **Luck** ensures that you can "cripple" body parts after a few hits. It is also possible to use a rifle with the 2nd legendary perk “50% more body part damage”. This also leads to crippling. Of course, both together are even faster, but the tormentor alone is enough.

## Shotguns/Heavy Gunner Builds:

With the perk card "**One Arms Army**" under luck you can cripple a body part with **heavy weapons** with a relatively low chance. With **shotguns** the best option is the perk card "**Emphatically**" under Agility.

Maybe you already know what the best option is here: a pepper shaker

- Is a shotgun and at the same time a heavy weapon
- Is very suitable as an alternative weapon for heavy gunner builds
- Combined with "Force" will cripple a body part very quickly
- Works even better if there is additional body part damage as a 2nd legendary perk on the pepper shaker.

For heavy gunners, for example: A plasma thrower is definitely a good option too. Due to the high precision and range, the tip will also work with this. However, only the "One Weapon Army" perk is used, which only has a small chance of crippling. A plasma thrower with body part damage would be a good choice here.

## Pistol Builds

With the "Hip Gold" card it is also possible to cripple body parts with pistols

## Legendary Effect: Body Part Damage

The 2nd legendary effect "+50% more body part damage" is also suitable for crippling on its own or as an addition to the perk cards. With this effect you need significantly fewer hits than without it.

## Application

Once you have decided on the right variant and equipped the perks, you can get started.

- Brandbeast or Queen flies towards you
- **Enable VATS**
- Use the right stick on the console controller or on the PC with the "A" or "D" keys **aim at a wing in the VATS**
- On the respective body part, i.e. wing, there is a **small bar for the condition**. You now shoot until the bar there is empty, then the **wing is crippled**.
- If your VATS deactivates as a heavy gunner, keep trying to hit the wings. This also helps with your perks.
- Shortly afterwards the Brandbeste or Queen lands.

We have been sharing this tip with our infographic in various posts on Facebook and Discord since 2019 in order to reach more people:

![](/uploads/71751164-260781051546359-2726909924897456128-n.jpg)
